data.name: Placidus
data.gender_notes: Placidus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word placidus, meaning 'calm' or 'peaceful'. In Christianity, Placidus is the name of several saints, most notably Saint Placidus of Assyria and Saint Placidus of Spain. The name Placidus carries the meaning “Calm, peaceful, tranquil” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Placidus usually hope their child will grow to embody calm, peaceful, tranquil and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner peace and calmness, reflecting one's tranquil character and resilience.
data.etymology: Placidus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Calm, peaceful, tranquil.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Placidus total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: פלאקידוס
in_hebrew.meaning: שם פלאקידוס הוא שם שליו ורגוע במשמעותו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פלאקידוס הוא שם שמקורו בלטינית ומשמעותו 'רגוע' או 'שליו'. השם נגזר מהמילה הלטינית 'placidus', שפירושה 'נעים', 'רגוע' או 'עדין'. השם פלאקידוס משמש כזכר ונקשר לאיכויות של רוגע ושלווה. בהקשר הנוצרי, השם עשוי לסמל את השלווה והאמונה באלוהים.

in_greek.name: Πλάκιδος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Πλάκιδος είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από το λατινικό 'placidus', που σημαίνει 'ειρηνικός' ή 'ήσυχος'. Το όνομα συνδέεται με την έννοια της ηρεμίας και της γαλήνης. Στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία, το όνομα μπορεί να συμβόλιζε την πνευματική ειρήνη και την υπομονή. Ο Πλάκιδος είναι ένα όνομα που φέρει την έννοια της σταθερότητας και της ψυχικής γαλήνης.

in_latin.name: Placidus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Placidus is derived from the Latin word 'placidus', which means 'calm', 'peaceful', or 'serene'. This name was used to signify tranquility and composure. In early Christian tradition, Placidus represented a person of peaceful nature and spiritual calmness. The name reflects qualities of serenity and stability.

in_english.name: Placidus
in_english.meaning: Placidus means calm, peaceful, or serene
in_english.long_meaning: The name Placidus originates from the Latin 'placidus', meaning 'calm' or 'peaceful'. It carries connotations of serenity and tranquility. In Christian tradition, Placidus is associated with Saint Placidus, a 6th-century monk known for his piety and calm demeanor. The name symbolizes spiritual peace and composure, reflecting a gentle and harmonious personality. Historically, it has been used in various Christian cultures to denote a peaceful and devout individual.

data.cultural_impact: The name Placidus probably evokes images of calmness and peace to many people, as its Latin roots suggest. For some, this could be seen as particularly appealing due to the often-chaotic nature of modern life. In various Christian traditions, the name Placidus is a reminder of the inner peace that can be found through faith and the teachings of Jesus.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Placidus carries a deeper spiritual significance. It is a reflection of the calmness and peace that can be found in a strong relationship with God. In the continuing struggle against the turbulence and chaos of the world, Placidus points us towards the tranquility that comes from the knowledge of God's love and guidance. This inner peace acts as a source of strength and inspiration in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Placidus: Derived from the Latin word 'placidus' meaning 'calm, peaceful, tranquil'. This name symbolizes a calm and serene spirit, a soul at peace with itself and the world. In Christian tradition, St. Placidus is a martyr who was tortured for his faith, yet his name serves as a reminder that even in suffering, one can maintain inner peace and calmness.

historical_references.reference: Placidus was a 4th-century Roman soldier who served under the emperor Valentinian I. He was known for his piety and was eventually appointed as a count and given the title Placidus the Pious.

Placidus was a 6th-century bishop of the Diocese of O Bergamo in northern Italy. He is known for his efforts to spread Christianity in the region and for his role in the Council of Trent, where he defended the orthodoxy of the Catholic faith against Protestant challenges.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Placidus has roots in early Roman history and is often associated with figures such as Placidus the Consul or Placidus the Martyr. In modern contexts, Placidus is primarily seen in discussions related to Roman history and Roman Catholicism. It can be found on various platforms including Wikipedia, where users can learn about the historical figures bearing this name, on LinkedIn, where professionals might have this name as part of their profile, and on Reddit, where communities dedicated to Roman history or Catholicism might mention individuals named Placidus in their discussions.
